header.settings.title: Settings
help.matrix.body: The base image whose identity and structure AXION must preserve.
help.reference.body: Optional inspiration for style, light, color or background; it does not replace the Matrix.
help.compare.body: Open an image and drag the slider to inspect differences from the original.
help.conversation.body: On: each edit builds on the visible version. Off: every edit starts from the original.
help.identity.body: Optional project identity used to restore work and name exports reliably.
help.newConversation.body: Returns to the original and removes this project's edits; it does not clear the general history.
help.useAsOriginal.body: Turns the visible edited version into the new base image and restarts its versions.
help.clearHistory.body: Deletes prompt history, including favorites; it does not remove the image or active project.
help.style.body: Adds or removes this style from the next creation or edit.
help.template.body: Loads this template into the instruction box; it does not generate until you press the main button.
